description.en: Export your views as JSON-LD or PNG.
description.it: Esporta le tue viste in formato JSON-LD o PNG.
description.zh-CN: 将视图导出为 JSON-LD 或 PNG。

documentation.en: Export saves the invoked view as JSON-LD or a high-resolution PNG with the current theme. Overview exports the complete graph. PNG includes all concepts and internal relations, without canvas controls or selection.
documentation.it: Export salva la vista invocata in JSON-LD o come PNG ad alta risoluzione con il tema corrente. Panoramica esporta il grafo completo. Il PNG include tutti i concetti e le relazioni interne, senza controlli o selezione.
documentation.zh-CN: 将调用的视图保存为 JSON-LD 或使用当前主题的高分辨率 PNG。概览导出完整图谱。PNG 包含所有概念和内部关系，不含画布控件或选中状态。

pngExportedDescription.en: PNG file saved or download requested.
pngExportedDescription.it: File PNG salvato o download avviato.
pngExportedDescription.zh-CN: PNG 文件已保存或下载已开始。

viewExportedDescription.en: JSON-LD file saved or download requested.
viewExportedDescription.it: File JSON-LD salvato o download avviato.
viewExportedDescription.zh-CN: JSON-LD 文件已保存或下载已开始。
